description: This file defines a React component for a shop page in an e-commerce application. It manages layout, routing, and UI elements such as product filters, sorting options, pagination, and route-based subcomponents for products, categories, and brands.

classes.name: Shop
classes.description: React component representing the shop page, including product listing, filters, sorting, and routing.

methods.description: Renders the shop page layout, including filters, sorting, routing, and pagination.
